title: Engine Performance
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to use technical skills and safety principles required for employment in the transportation and related industries performing engine performance work.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to assess, evaluate, and solve engine performance problems common to automotive, industrial, and agricultural industries.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate core engine performance skills.

notes: The requirements table prints codes without a space (AUTOB20, AUTOB30, AUTOB33, AUTOB34); these were matched to closed-list AUTO B20, AUTO B30, AUTO B33, AUTO B34, so they are not marked as catalog additions.

The description names employers and workplaces (automotive dealerships, independent repair shops, performance shops, construction companies, agriculture companies, government agencies, transportation and vehicle fleet repair shops) rather than careers or job titles, so careers was left empty. A reviewer may want to check this reading.
The description mentions ASE A8/L1 certification and BAR Specified Diagnostic and Repair training, which lead toward a California State Smog Repair License. These were not recorded as careers.
A grade of "C" or "P" is required in each course.
